class.name: LRTInstanceGeometryData
class.brief_description: Stores one instance's object-space Color SDF bake.
class.description: Stores distance and effective material color for one mesh instance, independent of volume spacing. The data property is serialized but hidden from the Inspector. Resource changes emit [signal Resource.changed].

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the object-space SDF domain, or an empty AABB before baking.

method.name: get_grid_size
method.description: Returns the SDF sample dimensions, or zero before baking.

method.name: get_distance_scale
method.description: Returns the positive object-space distance represented by a SNORM16 value of 1, or zero before baking.

method.name: has_data
method.description: Returns whether a complete bake has been assigned.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns an independent copy of the bake dictionary. Sample order is x-fastest. distance stores little-endian SNORM16 (outside positive, inside negative), color stores linear RGBA8, and optional emission stores three FP32 RGB values per sample. The domain includes two sample cells of padding. A fully transparent instance records receiver_only=true with a minimal positive-distance grid; its binding is excluded from runtime geometry scheduling. Opaque geometry is a frozen native GPU material/vertex snapshot. The baker also records source_mesh and, for contributing geometry, source_materials and source_resolution for provenance; these fields do not automatically invalidate the bake when source resources are edited.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Validates and replaces the complete payload; invalid data leaves the previous bake unchanged. Requires bounds (AABB), grid_size (Vector3i), distance_scale (float), distance and color (PackedByteArray), and emission (PackedFloat32Array, empty when absent). All dimensions must be at least 2. An empty dictionary clears the bake.
